sec.title: September 5 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 820)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **September 5** across inspirational family drama on Father Patrick Peyton's *Family Theater* (Stephen McNally in 1951; Ruth Hussey in 1956), Leslie Charteris's gentleman thief in *The Saint* starring Brian Aherne for Campbell's Soup (1945), grand operatic variety on *The Magic Key of RCA* featuring baritone Richard Bonelli and maestro Frank Black (1937), Baby Snooks magazine scams for Maxwell House (1940), and scientific history on *Adventures in Research* exploring Stephen Hales's plant physiology discoveries (1950), Richard Bonelli (1937), Fanny Brice (1940), and Brian Aherne (1945):
